stemMarkdown: A can do a piece of work in 20 days. A and B working together finish it in 5 days. How many days would B alone take? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Together they do $\dfrac{1}{5}$ of the work per day and A alone does $\dfrac{1}{20}$, so B's daily rate is $\dfrac{1}{5} - \dfrac{1}{20} = 0.150000$. B alone needs $6.6667$ days.
